title: ♞ The Four Knights Club
description: Yandex.Practicum test assignment — pixel-perfect responsive layout built from a Figma design. A stylized promo landing page inspired by chapter XXXIV of Ilf and Petrov's novel The Twelve Chairs — the Vasyuki chess tournament, the 'Fruitful Opening Idea' lecture, and a simultaneous exhibition match on 160 boards.

title: Alterras
description: Next.js 16 + Supabase companion app for a homebrew tabletop RPG: character sheets, world lore, interactive spell tree and GM tools. Full-stack rewrite of DnD-spellbook

title: Kamakura Food
description: Dynamic menu & shopping cart for a Japanese restaurant landing page. Frontend training exercise — vanilla JS DOM manipulation, no frameworks.

title: F5FLIX
description: Netflix-style landing page & catalog — static HTML/CSS training exercise built during the Factoria F5 frontend bootcamp.

title: Battle Simulator
description: An educational Java project that simulates battles between characters and manages their statistics using data structures such as HashMap, ArrayList, and Set. It includes file input/output, a simple text-based interface, and an interactive menu.

title: Escape Room Web.png
description: Interactive GTA-themed browser escape room built in vanilla JS/HTML/CSS as part of a 3-person team; implemented core game logic, DOM-based state navigation, and win/lose flow.
